title: Qualify stable selection and bounded expression diagnostics
commitMessage: feat: qualify stable exact selection and neutral expression diagnostics

contribution.summary: Observe two missing-public-API REDs; integrate indexed stable first-tie min/max selection and bounded neutral expression diagnostics, verify eleven new exact selection/error oracles and full regressions, and complete C03 and M1-W02.
contribution.value: Finishes the autonomous exact units-and-expressions vertical with deterministic tie behavior, fixed error codes, bounded diagnostics that never echo user input and all prior exact grammar and explicit-profile qualifications.
debtChanges: Evaluated quantities do not retain full parse-tree provenance; ExactSelection exposes the winning input index separately.
Fixed neutral English diagnostic messages are not localized user presentation, which remains host policy.
Public expression budget limits are qualified on tested input scopes, not a universal CPU/memory guarantee or AURA host adoption.

Retry 0 failed before attempt allocation: C# payload CS0219 rejected two unused constants, FirstRed and SecondRed. Retry 1 removes those declarations without changing RED tests, SDK operations, lifecycle transitions or validation gates.
contribution.nextAction: Advance M1-W03-C01 from the native roadmap, qualifying standalone Math package consumers and authority without modifying any sibling repository.

achievements.achievement: Independent prechange RED observes the missing public stable selection-index contract.
ExactSelection implements stable indexed minimum and maximum, preserves the first equal operand and is used by the exact expression parser.
Direct tests verify min(1 m,100 cm), first-operand ties, nested min/max, abs(-2 m), incompatible dimensions and temperature constraints.
The functional selection contract progresses from independent RED through integrated exact selection and qualification.
Independent prechange RED observes the missing neutral bounded expression diagnostics contract.
Every defined expression failure maps to a stable unique neutral code and a fixed bounded message preserving returned position without echoing user input.

Wrong arity, unknown functions, incompatible dimensions, absolute-temperature abs, ambiguity and division by zero are qualified with eleven new focused oracles plus full locked Math/foundation regressions.
The diagnostic and error-boundary contract is completed from RED to a qualified public API with fixed bounded messages.
The selection and error chunk completes with exact stable ties, selected-operand indices, neutral diagnostics and durable tested evidence.

All units-and-expressions chunks now carry validated evidence: inherited exact catalogue, bounded grammar and explicit profiles, and exact selection and neutral errors; the work package completes without external adoption claims.
